title: Where they lived in Chicago and Mr. Glaser's place
summary: Stella recalls living near 31st Street and 39th and Vernon in Chicago, and the Glaser dance hall and Plantation. The last block is garbled repetition.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Where did you live in Chicago? Do you remember which street it was about?

Yes. I lived on Prairie, near 31st. The first place I lived when we went to Chicago, we lived right on 39th Street, 39th and Vernon. That was it. Then Mr. Glazer had a place that I didn't know him then. But he had some kind of a place back there, a dance or something, a dance hall or something. I didn't go around that much to the place in Chicago because I was kind of strange, you know. But he had some, that's where Joe met him.
Later he had the sunset. I don't know what he had first before that. Well, it was a small place then. Small place too.
I think, I am not sure, so I won't say that. I thought he had the, I thought he had the plantation. But that, no, that plantation was a small place.
Later he, Joe had the place across the street where Louie played at the sunset and the plantation. I don't know. dear
